description: Authoritative WhatsApp Business Cloud API template registry for the n8n/API notification dispatcher. Register each meta_template_name in WhatsApp Manager (Utility category) before go-live. Money placeholders are pre-formatted server-side as K1,234.56 (integer ngwee).

order_confirmed_buyer.description: Sent to the buyer when payment is verified and the order is confirmed. Reinforces escrow trust.

bodies.en:
✅ *Order confirmed*

Your Vergeo5 order *{{1}}* is confirmed.

💰 Total: *{{2}}*
📦 Track: {{3}}

🔒 Your payment is held safely by Vergeo5 until delivery.

Reply STOP to opt out.
bodies.bem:
✅ *Order yasuminishwa*

Order yenu ya Vergeo5 *{{1}}* yasuminishwa.

💰 Total: *{{2}}*
📦 Tebula: {{3}}

🔒 Indalama yenu yikwata bwino na Vergeo5 mpaka kufika.

Lemeni STOP ukuleka.
bodies.nya:
✅ *Order yatsimikizidwa*

Order yanu ya Vergeo5 *{{1}}* yatsimikizidwa.

💰 Total: *{{2}}*
📦 Onani: {{3}}

🔒 Ndalama zanu zikusungidwa ndi Vergeo5 mpaka kutumiza.

Lembani STOP kuleka.

new_order_vendor.description: Alerts the vendor to a new paid/placed order. Prompts confirmation in the vendor app.

bodies.en:
🛒 *New order on Vergeo5*

Order *{{1}}*
📱 {{2}} × {{3}}

✅ Confirm and prepare in the vendor app.
💬 Need help? Reply here or open Vergeo5 Vendor.
bodies.bem:
🛒 *Order yambi pa Vergeo5*

Order *{{1}}*
📱 {{2}} × {{3}}

✅ Tukishisheni no kwipanga mu vendor app.
💬 Mufwaya ubufushi? Tubombeni pano nangu isuleni Vergeo5 Vendor.
bodies.nya:
🛒 *Order yatsopano pa Vergeo5*

Order *{{1}}*
📱 {{2}} × {{3}}

✅ Tsimikizani ndi kukonzekera mu vendor app.
💬 Mukufuna thandizo? Tiyeni pano kapena tsegulani Vergeo5 Vendor.

order_ready_for_pickup.description: Notifies the buyer that their order is ready for collection. Includes pickup landmark and QR/PIN link.

variables.name: pickup_details
variables.example: Collect at Kamwala Trading, stand 12. QR: https://vergeo5.com/en/pickup/ord-abc123

bodies.en:
📍 *Ready for pickup*

Your Vergeo5 order *{{1}}* is ready!

🏪 {{2}}

📲 Show your QR code or PIN at the vendor.
⏰ Collect during vendor opening hours.

Reply STOP to opt out.
bodies.bem:
📍 *Yikwete kale ku pickup*

Order yenu *{{1}}* yikwete!

🏪 {{2}}

📲 Longeni QR code nangu PIN kuli vendor.
⏰ Mutenge mu nshita sha kufungula kwa vendor.

Lemeni STOP ukuleka.
bodies.nya:
📍 *Yakonzeka kutengedwa*

Order yanu *{{1}}* yakonzeka!

🏪 {{2}}

📲 Onetsani QR code kapena PIN kwa vendor.
⏰ Mutengeni nthawi ya kutsegula kwa vendor.

Lembani STOP kuleka.

escrow_released_vendor.description: Notifies the vendor that the buyer confirmed receipt and escrow funds were released. Planned for M14 dispatcher wiring — submit to Meta before enabling.

bodies.en:
💸 *Payment released*

Escrow for order *{{1}}* is released.

💰 Amount: *{{2}}*
✅ Buyer confirmed receipt.

Funds will reach your wallet shortly.
📲 View payout: {{3}}

Reply STOP to opt out.

notes: order_confirmed_buyer, new_order_vendor, and order_ready_for_pickup map to live API template IDs today.

Submit emoji bodies to Meta as-is; Utility category with transactional tone only.
